registry_binding.qualification: Frozen M-CSA v5 source references: 2393 stored records; 1657 EXACT strict replay references, 736 DELTA_CONSISTENT references retained for diagnostics. Overlapping supporting/diagnostic view of the same native enzyme proposals; not independent data or extra tasks. Reconstructed initial components, when flagged, use mechanism-derived preconditions and are not independently observed endpoint inputs. Source transitions are ordered; arrows within a native drawing are one atomic group, not physical chronology. Native splits remain unassigned and development-exposure flags are preserved; replay consistency does not establish benchmark blindness or physical truth. Unsupported fishhooks, radical and covalent-metal cases remain outside the accepted conversion. All source identities, certificates, context and arrows are reference-only metadata, withheld from model inputs.
